title.en: Riverside Land Titles and the Shared Waterway

desc.zh: 河湾地契上写着的姓名与实际耕作者并不总是一致，河道疏浚的钱也没有固定的承担者。华人国要站稳，先把地权与水道的账目理清。
desc.en: The names on riverside deeds do not always match the people who actually farm the land, and nobody has agreed who pays to keep the channel clear. A Chinese polity on the Mekong must first put its land and waterway accounts in order.

title.en: Common Residents Beyond the Guild Hall

desc.zh: 会馆的册子记不下所有沿河居民。新来者、本地村社与下一代各有诉求，华人国必须决定谁能共享裁判、学校与席位。
desc.en: The guild hall's register cannot hold every riverside resident. Newcomers, local villages and the next generation each have claims, and the polity must decide who shares its courts, schools and seats.

title.zh: 河湾地契上的两种姓名
title.en: Two Names on the Riverside Deed

desc.zh: 同一块河湾田，会馆的旧册写着出资垦殖的乡人，官府的新册写着实际纳粮的耕户。两本册子都对了一半，也各错了一半。
desc.en: For the same riverside field, the guild's old ledger names the townsman who paid to clear it, while the government's new register names the household that actually pays the grain tax. Each book is half right, and half wrong.

label.en: Run both ledgers: record clearing and grain tax together

cost_note.en: Survey and registration fee: one week of opening income (deferred if the treasury cannot cover it).

consequence_note.zh: 垦殖出资人与纳粮耕户同册并录，争议由官府受理；下一站议水道。
consequence_note.en: Clearing investors and tax-paying households are recorded side by side, with disputes heard by the office; the waterway question follows.

label.zh: 旧册优先：会馆出资簿为准
label.en: Old ledger first: the guild's subscription book decides

consequence_note.en: Saves money and satisfies the guild, but farming households lose their written ground for appeal; grievance carries into the village question.

label.zh: 两册先各管各，暂不合并
label.en: Let each ledger keep its own books for now

consequence_note.zh: 决定押后，重复地契问题继续存在。
consequence_note.en: The decision is postponed; duplicate claims remain on the books.

label.zh: 此线不办，交由旧例
label.en: Drop this line; leave it to custom

consequence_note.zh: 本线结束，旧例继续；后续会馆线仍会提起同一笔旧账。
consequence_note.en: This line ends and custom continues; the guild line will still raise the same old accounts.

purpose.zh: 开线：登记地权争议并选定登记方式
purpose.en: Opening: register the land dispute and choose a registry

title.zh: 水道不能只由商行疏浚

desc.zh: 雨季一过，河口沙洲又抬高了。商行愿意包办疏浚，条件是独收三年过闸钱；官府自办则要真金白银。地权册子刚定，水道的账又来了。
desc.en: The sandbar at the outlet has risen again since the rains. The trading house offers to dredge it all, in exchange for three years of exclusive tolls; the government's own crews want real money. The land registers are barely settled and the waterway's bill has arrived.

consequence_note.en: The channel clears with no attached privileges; the line settles after twelve months of execution.

label.en: Contract the trading house: cash saved, tolls conceded

consequence_note.en: The channel still clears, but the concession is entered in the record; this line settles as a limited result.

label.en: Narrow self-work: clear only the official channel

cost_note.en: Half-run works: one week of opening income (deferred if the treasury cannot cover it).

consequence_note.zh: 商船水道依旧淤浅，贸易怨言会留到下一条线；本线按有限结果结算。
consequence_note.en: The merchant channel stays silted and the complaint carries into the next line; this line settles as a limited result.

purpose.en: Choose who dredges and open the common-resident line

reads: land registry mode from the previous choice

title.en: Newcomers Ask the Guild Hall for Protection

desc.zh: 又一批顺水下来的同乡到了码头，没有地、没有铺、只有会馆门口的一封引荐信。收不收册，收册之后算谁的人，会馆第一次答不上来。
desc.en: Another boatload of fellow townsfolk has drifted downriver: no land, no shop, only a letter of introduction at the guild gate. Whether to enter them, and whose people they become afterwards, is a question the guild cannot answer alone for the first time.

consequence_note.zh: 新来者入会馆册，会馆动员力增强，但本地村社视其为外来人。
consequence_note.en: Newcomers enter the guild register and the hall's reach grows, but local villages treat them as outsiders.

label.en: Office register: residency enters the public roll

consequence_note.en: Once the public roll stands, villages and traders alike begin citing the same resident record.

label.en: Hold the register: send them to find their own footing

consequence_note.en: The money stays, but unease at the docks accumulates.

title.zh: 本地村社要求共同裁判
title.en: The Villages Demand a Shared Bench

desc.en: The village elders arrive with a sheet pressed full of thumbprints: cases touching both communities cannot be decided by the guild's directors alone. What they want is not a verdict but a place where reasons can be heard.

title.en: The First Officials from the Two-Tongue School

desc.en: The school's first class has finished: guild children and village children studied in the same room and now wait for the same vacancies. The roll lies on the desk, but the rules for office are still the old ones.

desc.en: The land rolls, the court and the school accounts all lie open: this polity shelters more than the guild's umbrella now. Whether to write that widened duty into its charter is this generation's question to answer.
